questions.question: How many flight activity records are classified under the budget or low fare price category?
questions.program:

result = int((df['Price Category Code'] == 'Low Fare').sum())

questions.question: Which world region outside of the United States has the largest number of flight activity entries in this report?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('sf_air_traffic_passenger_statistics.csv')
non_us = df[df['GEO Region'] != 'US']
result = str(non_us['GEO Region'].value_counts().index[0])

questions.question: Does international flight activity account for more reporting entries than domestic flight activity?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('sf_air_traffic_passenger_statistics.csv')
counts = df['GEO Summary'].value_counts()
result = 'yes' if counts.get('International', 0) > counts.get('Domestic', 0) else 'no'
